Areev is licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE-MIT` and
`LICENSE-APACHE`). Binary distributions (the `areev` and `areev-sandbox`
binaries, the PyPI wheel and the npm addon) statically link the third-party
crates below. The Python and npm packages declare no runtime dependencies of
their own. Full license texts ship in each crate's source distribution via
crates.io.

## Turso Database (MIT)

Areev's storage engine embeds [Turso Database](https://github.com/tursodatabase/turso)
(`turso`, `turso_core` and related crates).
